_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::ehl#1, and a FALSIFICATION of its Signal. The entry claimed near-contact 'gives pressure NaN or singular Reynolds stiffness matrix'. The minimum-film-height regularisation it recommends already exists as LUBRICATION DYNAMIC/GAP_OFFSET (default 0); upstream ehl3d_mixed.4C.yaml sets it to 0.0025. Setting it to 0 runs all 20 time steps, prints no NaN, no Inf, nothing containing 'singular' and no film-height remark, and returns a finite lubricant pressure and a full set of finite displacements that are simply wrong — 5 of the deck's 7 result tests move, including the node-84 x displacement flipping sign. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C (2026.2.0-dev, commit 89519cfe76).
